whereabouts: At nine o'clock, when the temple struck, Madame and the others took their watches out of their pockets for the annual showing.
Félix's watch was shown at that time, in front of everyone.
Monsieur Girard and Madame's husband quarrelled about the price of the repeater; this was in answer to the question about a quarrel at the table.
Afterwards the family went through to the salon.
Madame was in the salon when the temple struck ten.
Casimir and Madame sat down to piquet in the salon and played without a break.
Casimir went out at 10:28 by the salon clock to fetch his cigars.
Before going out, Casimir asked Madame to play for him.
After Casimir left, Madame sat down at the piano at once and played Chopin until he came back.
Madame stopped playing when Casimir came back in.
Casimir came back, and a moment later the hall clock struck eleven.
Madame was never allowed in the atelier.
The interview itself took place in the dining room, with Madame present.
